lockFileMaintenance.description: Transitive deps only move during lock file maintenance. Without its own schedule this inherits the top-level `every 30 day`, which overrides the weekly cadence from `:maintainLockFilesWeekly` and lets vulnerable sub-dependencies (tar, minimatch, brace-expansion, ...) sit stale for months. Automerged because these PRs otherwise queue up unreviewed -- `:automergeMinor` does not cover lock file maintenance, so they are not picked up by any other rule. Renovate holds the merge until the `Build & Deploy` checks are green.

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 (the Go port) has no stable programmatic API for Volar/vue-tsc yet, so it cannot type-check .vue templates. Revisit once vue-tsc supports it.
